cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a foley recording booth with microphones and boxes of noisy props — carries an acoustic guitar by its neck at her side; a castle bathhouse with a stone pool — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — lying on her front; an old Chengdu teahouse with bamboo chairs — crouching low on her heels; A night tram interchange with red and turquoise light reflected in the glass roof — She watches the last two trams pass in opposite directions before deciding which side of the city to visit; a self-service car wash bay — holds her keepsake at chest height; A sheltered mountain swimming cove with a dawn-lit floating timber platform — She tests whether the first sunlight has reached the water before taking her morning swim; a medieval guild workshop — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a rocky waterfall pool under green trees — swimming breaststroke; a monastery library of tall wooden shelves — lying on her front; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; an old brush-and-ink shop in a heritage quarter — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a rooftop drying terrace with laundry lines overhead — lifts a small storage box onto the shelf above her
